items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: We had Dick Johnson on clarinet. He played clarinet on that.

ctx.x: Society. Yeah, yeah. Our society and uh... Oh, I forgot.
We had Dick Johnson on clarinet. He played clarinet on that. Fred Weiss played piano. Who was on drums? Ben Borders. Ben Borders.
He died, didn't he? Yes. Yes.
Wade had been with you all that time?
Yeah. But we got Dink. Wills and Spice had to go Dink. I don't know. Something. I don't know. We got a hold of him. I don't know.
Well, they did one of Dink's tunes too. That was the Ticket Blues. Yeah.
